job.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 track B (one die type): control leaf of the merged-die KV sequencer cluster qkd_seq (new RTL: the KV sequencer + the ROM-end x3 buffer without the D2D adapters + the die's stage stepper ot_qfd_dctl on the ROM sequencer's raw pins). Every pin a register, own root: N = ROM side (x3 valid / tag / credit, r_sd 56 status levels, kvd launcher, RES to the VM under 64 reserved credits, t_ds 187 stage-step + write words, program write copy t_pw), S = hub RES / host step + result levels / fault word, W / E = fan control (own copies), N = store control. M5 leaf, recipe 2.

benches.name: seq_equiv_exact
benches.note: cluster qkd_seq (wires-only parent + core + 4 xs + 4 fan) == flat ot_qkvd_kv_seq_merged on every output bit of every cycle: 96,336 cycles, 160 layers (kvd launches), 49 decode steps through the stage stepper against a ROM-sequencer model (stage order, token / position, result checked) + one step per stepper fault kind, host program / descriptor writes checked on both copies, credit-true traffic on every bundle, every output bit seen at 0 and 1, per-quadrant row-credit protocol checked

benches.name: seq_equiv_wire_mutant
benches.note: OT_QKD_SEQ_MUT: the parent swaps two store slices on the E copies of the q word

benches.name: seq_equiv_coverage_refusal
benches.note: a run of 8 layers is refused: the pass needs the traffic counts and full toggle coverage

benches.name: layer_cluster_exact
benches.note: the KV-end attention layer step through the CLUSTER (Verilator, STACK=h): 7 vectors x VM stall 0/1 x launch by dc ATTN / by kvd descriptor, bit-exact against tools/qwen_nearhbm_attn_ref.py
